product.name: Monoprice Commercial Series 5x1 TV Ceiling Mount for Portrait Display Menu Boards Fits 32 to 65 TVs with Adjustable Tilt
product.description: Monoprice™Commercial Series 5×1 TV Ceiling Mount for Portrait Display Menu Boards, Fits 32" to 65" TVs with Adjustable TiltThe Monoprice Commercial Series 5×1 TV Ceiling Mount (P/N 49337) is designed for professional digital signage and menu board installations that require five portrait oriented displays in a single vertical column. It supports 32" to 65" TVs, offers adjustable tilt for improved readability, and mounts all displays from a single ceiling drop for clean, space efficient installations. This mount is ideal for high content menu boards where vertical screen stacking maximizes information density without increasing wall or ceiling clutter.FIVE PORTRAIT DISPLAYS FROM ONE CEILING DROPThe mount uses a vertical rail system engineered for a 5×1 portrait configuration, supporting five displays from a single ceiling pole assembly. This design reduces ceiling penetration while maintaining consistent spacing and alignment across all screens. ADJUSTABLE TILT FOR OVERHEAD READABILITYEach display interface supports fixed tilt positions up to 15°, allowing installers to optimize viewing angles based on ceiling height and audience distance. PORTRAIT ORIENTATION SUPPORTThe mount supports 90° portrait orientation, ensuring secure alignment for vertically mounted displays commonly used in menu boards and information kiosks. EXTENDED VERTICAL RAIL FOR TALL MENU BOARDSThe vertical rail assembly accommodates five displays in a single column, with a total rail height of approximately 4010mm (157.9in). Ceiling drop adjustment ranges from 580mm (22.8 in) minimum to 1550mm (61.0in) maximum, making it suitable for standard commercial ceiling heights. COMMERCIAL GRADE STEEL CONSTRUCTIONThe mount is constructed from steel and includes concrete anchors and lag bolts for secure ceiling installation. It is intended for indoor commercial use only and should be installed by qualified professionals. PACKAGE CONTENTS• Ceiling pole sections• Vertical display rail (5 screen configuration)• Five display mounting brackets• Concrete anchors and lag bolts• Assorted M5, M6, and M8 fasteners• Hardware Installation Pack• Printed user manual .gte-ctr .row{margin:0;}Lifetime WarrantyWith Monoprice's Lifetime Warranty, you can rest assured we stand behind our products and our customers.
